text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: I was visiting a trendy Italian restaurant with Sounds of Earth.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Bene!
What a wonderful atmosphere. The subdued interior really sets the mood for a fine meal.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now then,
I wonder what's on the menu?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
“Prosciutto and Cheese Antipasto Misto,”
“Fresh Basil Margherita,”
“House-made Bacon Carbonara”...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Fantastico!
Every single one of them looks truly delicious.
choice_data_list: So many things on the menu, I can't decide...
So many things on the menu, I'm not sure what to pick...

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Fufu, at times like this, you should just listen closely.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
If you do that, can you hear it?
The melody of overflowing gourmet delights...
choice_data_list: (…Though all I can hear is the store's background music.)

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"A capriccio played freely by prosciutto...
Olive oil flowing teneramente...
A serenade in unison with eggplant and tomato..."

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah...
What a sweet sinfonia!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: And the one that sounds exceptionally blissful is—

text_block_list.name: Floor Staff
text_block_list.text: Have you decided on your order?

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Ah, ready to order!
This antipasto, the salad, for pizzas this one and this one, and this pasta please. For the meat dish—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Sounds of Earth ordered dish after dish in rapid succession.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Oops, this won't do.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The gourmet sirens sang so sweetly
that it seems they completely swept me away.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: I almost ended up binge-eating back there.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Maestro!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Thank you, Maestra!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
Now, the first dish has arrived.
Let us savor it to our heart's content.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The food was just as exquisite as the rumors said.
Sounds of Earth ate a moderate amount, thoroughly satisfied.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
"That's what I like to hear!
Now then, continuing with the order."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dish after dish lines the table.
We were supposed to have come for Italian,
but it feels practically like a full-course Manchu-Han banquet.

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
What an ornately adorned full orchestra!
This is the true delizioso my heart has longed for!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text:
The fragrance wafting through Calmato is an overture to fine dining.
And how truly brillante the meticulously
adorned dishes are!

text_block_list.name: Sounds of Earth
text_block_list.text: Now, which tone should I savor first?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And Sounds of Earth proceeded to finish
every single bite of the massive feast he ordered.
